roles.name: EdgeSutra Prime
roles.scope: Chief orchestration, architecture, scope, planning and human-controlled release decisions

roles.name: Device Atlas
roles.scope: Inspect CPU, OS, memory, storage and published target-device constraints

roles.name: Silicon Scout
roles.scope: Assess GPU, NPU, DSP and accelerator driver visibility without presuming support

roles.name: Runtime Bridge
roles.scope: Map ONNX Runtime, LiteRT, ExecuTorch, Core ML, OpenVINO and llama.cpp interfaces

roles.name: Model Cartographer
roles.scope: Inspect model file metadata, graphs, opsets, sizes and provenance

roles.name: Operator Sentinel
roles.scope: Compare operator, datatype and opset requirements with runtime capabilities

roles.name: Graph Surgeon
roles.scope: Plan supported graph transformations and operator substitutions with safety gates

roles.name: Quantization Alchemist
roles.scope: Plan post-training quantization and quantization-aware strategies

roles.name: Calibration Steward
roles.scope: Assess representative calibration data and privacy or bias constraints

roles.name: Quality Witness
roles.scope: Measure model/task correctness and compare outputs after conversion

roles.name: Latency Lab
roles.scope: Benchmark cold/warm inference latency, throughput, jitter and confidence

roles.name: Memory Guardian
roles.scope: Evaluate model footprint, RAM, peak residency and allocator limits

roles.name: Energy Boundary
roles.scope: Separate sensor-measured energy from estimates and unspecified quantities

roles.name: Thermal Observer
roles.scope: Plan thermal throttling, sustained-load and battery impact verification

roles.name: Offline Guardian
roles.scope: Audit offline readiness, remote network dependency and private data handling

roles.name: Artifact Provenance
roles.scope: Track model weights, hashes, licenses, toolchains and signatures

roles.name: Deployment Gate
roles.scope: Check device release suitability and require explicit operator approvals

roles.name: IDE Bridge
roles.scope: Adapt canonical Agent Skills to supported IDE discovery paths

roles.name: Security Sentinel
roles.scope: Review model-file parsing, supply chain, sandbox and credentials

roles.name: Release Auditor
roles.scope: Independent tests, traceability, reproducibility and truthful compatibility statuses
